NIGHT
INSPECTOR

The Shape Museum

The Shape Museum needs a Night Inspector. Five vault doors are sealed.
Only your five inspection reports can open them. Nobody has seen what's inside.

The museum files reports without judging them — the archive is opened later. Every filed report turns a lock, so all five doors open no matter what you write. If you are not sure about an exhibit, you may file it as Unresolved. That is normal inspector work.

Door 1 of 5

The Curator
walking to the next door…

THE VAULT IS OPEN

Inspector's badge embossed with the vault emblem. The museum keeps every report exactly as you filed it. Nothing is marked tonight — the archive is opened later.

SHIFT ENDED

Thank you, Inspector. The museum has your reports.

The vault simply waits for the next shift. Nothing is marked tonight.

Reading the report line

Are you sure?

FILED
